title: LSTM RUL — Severson 2019 reproduction + ONNX edge inference
description: PyTorch 2-layer LSTM (hidden=64) trained on per-cycle summary features from 138 LFP cells (Severson 2019 batches 1+2+3). Exported to ONNX and benchmarked under onnxruntime CPU as a proxy for the STM32N6 NPU deployment path.
